purpose: Per-file provenance and rights record for the 17 research-source card images. Every file in this directory is a first-party procedural graphic generated by generate-replacements.py; keep this manifest in sync when regenerating (sha256 must match the shipped file).

production.externalAssets: none — gradients, geometric motifs and typography drawn in code only
production.fonts: Noto Sans/Serif CJK (SIL OFL 1.1) used at render time only; font files are not distributed, glyph embedding in raster graphics is permitted

rights.basis: Self-produced procedural graphic created for this replacement; contains no third-party image, logo, screenshot or photograph. The displayed source name is a nominative reference to the data source the card introduces, not a reproduced trademark/logo artwork.

replaces.reason: Original file (pre-2026-10-14) had no provenance record: visual inspection showed a thematic illustration with no logo/screenshot, but its production channel was not recorded anywhere in the repo, so its rights could not be established (license audit REPORT issue 9; asset-license-determinations: unclear — replacement recommended).
